faqs.question: What exactly does Automation Nitro include?
faqs.answer: Automation Nitro covers test automation setup from scratch or improvement of existing automation, including framework setup, test creation, CI/CD integration, and best practices.

faqs.question: Is Automation Nitro suitable if we don't have automation yet?
faqs.answer: Yes. This service is designed both for products without automation and for teams with unstable or poorly maintained test automation.

faqs.question: What types of tests do you automate?
faqs.answer: We focus on high-value automated tests such as regression, smoke, critical user flows, and API tests — not low-impact or flaky scenarios.

faqs.question: Which tools and technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We select tools based on your stack and needs, commonly using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, API automation tools, and integrating them into your existing CI/CD pipeline.

faqs.question: How fast will we see results?
faqs.answer: Initial value is usually delivered within 2 weeks, with automated tests running as part of your release process shortly after.

faqs.question: Will our team be able to maintain the automation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build clean, maintainable automation, provide documentation, and can onboard your team or continue supporting automation if needed.

faqs.question: How do you ensure automation actually saves time and money?
faqs.answer: We automate only what makes sense for your product and measure impact through reduced regression time, faster releases, and fewer production issues.

faqs.question: What exactly do you audit?
faqs.answer: We audit your QA process, test coverage, tools, documentation, environments, and release risks to identify gaps that impact product quality and delivery speed.

faqs.question: When do I need a QA audit?
faqs.answer: A QA audit is needed when you face frequent production bugs, unstable releases, slow QA cycles, or want an external, unbiased quality assessment.

faqs.question: How is a QA audit different from regular testing?
faqs.answer: Testing finds bugs. A QA audit explains why bugs appear, evaluates the entire quality process, and provides clear, actionable improvements.

faqs.question: What deliverables will I receive?
faqs.answer: You receive a structured audit report with: Identified risks and gaps, Quality metrics, Prioritized recommendations, Clear next steps for improvement.

faqs.question: How long does the QA audit take?
faqs.answer: Most audits take 1–2 weeks, depending on product complexity and current QA maturity.

faqs.question: Do you help implement the audit recommendations?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can support implementation, optimize your QA process, or continue with testing and automation based on audit results.

faqs.question: Is this audit suitable for small or early-stage teams?
faqs.answer: Yes. Early audits help set up a scalable QA foundation, avoiding costly quality mistakes as the codebase grows.

faqs.question: What is QA Candidate Assessment?
faqs.answer: It’s a service where we evaluate QA candidates (manual and automation) for skills, mindset, and real-world problem solving before you hire them.

faqs.question: What does the assessment include?
faqs.answer: We assess technical skills, test design, automation logic, API knowledge, reporting clarity, and scenario thinking through real tasks and interviews.

faqs.question: Who is this assessment for?
faqs.answer: For companies hiring QA engineers (Junior, Middle, Senior) who want a trusted, objective evaluation before making hiring decisions.

faqs.question: How long does the assessment take?
faqs.answer: Assessment typically takes 1–3 days per candidate, depending on level and test depth.

faqs.question: Do you provide detailed feedback?
faqs.answer: Yes — you receive a report with strengths, weaknesses, and recommendations for each candidate.

faqs.question: Can you assess candidates in our stack/tech?
faqs.answer: Yes — we tailor assessments to your technology stack, tooling, and project specifics.

faqs.question: How does this save time and cost?
faqs.answer: We reduce bad hires and rework, help you focus only on qualified candidates, and improve hiring ROI.
